name: Mikshuana
source: A sixth-ranked angel was sent to the Kingdom of Influss on a mission from the Temple of Marzteria. She currently resides in Guaracuna Fortress to watch over Avaro, who has acquired the ability to create the "Magic Stone that Seals God." Despite being highly skilled, she is cautious about her attitude and tone of voice, as she was given a senior position at a young age. At times, her true feelings show, and she has to cover them up. She often gains new knowledge from popular books and is easily influenced. She is seeking a way to address the teasing she experiences from all sides and seems to be searching for a solution in popular books.
